description:
A DIALOGUE WITH WOMEN.WITH THE BODY, WITH TIME, WITH CRAFT.WITH AZZEDINE, AND WITH THE ENDURING CODES OF THE MAISON.

CLOTHES WRAP AND REVEAL, EXPLORING THE RELATIONSHIP BETWEEN CLOTH AND SKIN, FORM AND FUNCTION. SILHOUETTES AMPLIFY THE FIGURE WITHIN ,AN EXPRESSION OF FREEDOM, FEMININITY AND MOVEMENT.

PAST AND PRESENT EXIST IN CONTINUUM. HERITAGE IS FELT RATHER THAN STATED: IN A SEAM, A SILHOUETTE, A GESTURE, A WAY OF MAKING.

CRAFT IS AT THE HEART.A DIALOGUE WITHOUT BEGINNING OR END.

description:
IN PARTNERSHIP WITH CLAIRE DE ROUEN, THE MAISON WELCOMED NANCY HONEY FOR A CONVERSATION WITH BRANDEI ESTES, SENIOR CURATOR OF PHOTOGRAPHS AT NATIONAL PORTRAIT GALLERY. 

THEIR DISCUSSION WAS CENTERED AROUND NANCY HONEY'S BODY OF WORK WHICH HAS EXPLORED IDEAS OF INTIMACY, WOMANHOOD AND DESIRE FOR MORE THAN FOUR DECADES.
 
THIS FIRST CULTURAL CONVERSATION HOSTED BY ALAÏA CONSIDERED FASHION, PHOTOGRAPHY AND CULTURE, AND THE INTERSECTIONS BETWEEN THEM. 

A SELECTION OF BOOKS, CURATED BY BRANDEI ESTES, ACCOMPANIED THE OCCASION, BRINGING TOGETHER THEMES OF GIRLHOOD, DOMESTIC SPACE AND MEMORY. 

VIDEO BY CHANEL MOYE
title: ALAÏA — IN CONVERSATION WITH NANCY HONEY

description:
Presented on January 23rd in Paris, the Summer Fall 2024 collection is about simplicity and purity, about less meaning more - about intimacy, about reducing to an essence, about finding freedom and invention in that. It is a decision, a choice, not to minimize but to focus, to expand possibilities.

The entire collection is created using a single merino wool yarn, reinvented over and again with the Maison’s textile and knitwear suppliers, who have worked with Alaïa for four decades.

It is based on the curve, on the circle - the curves of women, and circles of friends, a chosen family, an idea essential to the essence of Alaïa. 

“For this show, I wanted to bring us all together, to view everything up close - close together, close to the clothes“ – Pieter Mulier.
title: ALAÏA SUMMER FALL 2024

description:
Shot by Tyrone Lebon, in a family atmosphere and with a very small crew, the campaign for the Summer Fall 2023 collection took place at Pieter Mulier’s home, in Antwerp, in the same space where the collection was created, developed and presented.

Mica, Julia and Anok — who personify the Alaïa woman envisioned by Pieter Mulier — instinctively seize the entirety of this intimate space. 

Under the profound light of the Flemish sky, the clothes become their second skin. A combination of ease, sexiness and effortless chic. 

Captured with no artifice, the Summer Fall 2023 campaign embodies Alaïa’s iconic vision of natural beauty. And its unique family spirit. The clothes, like the space, are personal, sculpted directly on the body, with a precise and yet instinctive structure. They remind us that the home is a vital component to Alaïa.

description:
Presented on July 2nd on a bridge in Paris - between Maison Alaïa’s origins and its present - the Winter Spring 24 collection explores time not as an abstract concept but a material notion - its signs and signifiers, its reflections through fashion.

Buttons, lines, garments - all the traces of the hands, essential to build the clothes, remain apparent. They echo all the different influences at the roots of this new collection.

Femininity is at the heart of every creation. More empowered than ever, magnified and sublimated. 
An ode to the Alaïa woman. 
To the feminine body, and its infinite movements.

description:
Complexities can be found in simplicity, a refinement discovered in the savage grace of the raw and brut. For the Winter-Spring Alaïa collection, Pieter Mulier investigates and celebrates the inherent contradiction at the heart of the Maison Alaïa, a tension between control and release. And this collection is presented within walls that resonate simultaneously with the past, and a future - a mythical Parisian address, 15 Faubourg Saint-Honoré, an expansion of the Maison Alaïa to open in 2024.

description:
With the Winter Spring 22 collection — the first under Pieter Mulier’s creative direction — a series of short movies unveils Alaïa’s signature codes in the form of subliminal images. In every epileptic and spirited apparitions, all the signatures of Alaïa's vocabulary — leather, denim, suit, bells, leopard print… — emerge, scattered with poetic visions. 

Alaïa commissioned the multi Grammy winner Alexandre Courtes to direct the campaign where you will discover the architectural aesthetic, the sexy visions and all the archetypes of the new Alaïa wardrobe.

Shot by Alexandre Courtes
Soundtrack by Nicolas Godin
Models : Raynara Negrine, Sherry Shi, Anya Ekung, Mirthe Dijk
Hair by Lukas Tralmer
Make-up by Christelle Cocquet

description:
Alaïa presents its Fall Winter 2021 collection both in the darkness of the Parisian streets and in the artificial studio lights.
Facing the camera and straightforwardly, the models reveal the season wardrobe combining craftmanship and innovation.
Leather and knit sculpt the silhouette. Laces draw camouflage motifs and graphic ruches.
The light emphasises the bags of the season: the Sidi and the Corset with their feminine curves and generous volumes, and the new Bucket Corset with its iconic perforations.

Soundtrack by Music Department (@musicdepartment) composed by Clara 3000 (@clara3000)
title: COLLECTION FALL WINTER 21

description:
Dancers Letizia Galloni and Hajiba Fahmy bring the ALAÏA RELAX collection to life, crafted entirely in the second-skin knit from the 1990s.

Filmed by Louis Evennou to the sound of Ya Man Hawa de Bedouin Burger, dancers Letizia and Hajiba communicate without words. They express themselves, without filter or colors, freely.

The Relax knit, like a protective and comfortable second skin, accompanies every one of their movements with effortlessness.

 #Alaïa #MaisonAlaïa
title: Alaïa Relax Collection

description:
Another perspective on Spring Summer ’21 with frames that give off a natural glow...
#Alaïa #MaisonAlaïa #AzzedineAlaïa
title: Alaïa Spring Summer 21 Eyewear collection

description:
Discovering with instinctive ease Spring '21 pieces that express glow and grace. Explore this new selection of pieces in subtle earth tones and graphic patterns that accentuate innovative and decorative techniques.
 #Alaïa #MaisonAlaïa #AzzedineAlaïa
title: The Spring 21 collection in movement

description:
Drawing inspiration from Mr. Alaïa’s attachment to Africa, the season’s airy shapes and accessories reimagine his couture craftsmanship with contemporary, everyday ease. Explore Alaïa's Spring Summer '21 silhouettes that transmit movement and lightness.
 #Alaïa #MaisonAlaïa #AzzedineAlaïa
title: Feel the breeze of the Alaïa Spring 21 collection

description:
Azzedine Alaïa worked on his own versions of a Safari jacket. In this design from 1990, the classic Safari jacket takes on the form of a vest. The garment is completely backless, stripped to the bare minimum: gusseted side pockets, minimalist military style buttons and a fun, oversized lapel collar.
#MaisonAlaïa #AzzedineAlaïa #AlaïaEditions #Alaïa
title: The Safari Jacket Summer 1990

description:
The monastic shape of this dress is emphasised by the simplicity of its drawstring waist. Yet its angelic appearance is underscored by the rhythm of its large horizontal bands with lace inlays, which reveal flashes of skin as the wearer moves.
#MaisonAlaïa #AzzedineAlaïa #AlaïaEditions #Alaïa
title: The Lace Band Dress Summer 2015

description:
From inside the mythic Alaïa fitting cabine, at rue de Moussy, friends of the house embody the timeless allure of the Editions wardrobe, faithfully reproduced from the archives between 1981 and 2017. A rediscovery of Alaïa's incomparable craftsmanship. Editions emphasize the relevance and enduring standards of Monsieur Alaïa’s work above fashion. Transcending time, the pieces represent creation in perpetuity. Heritage becomes transmission.
Music by @ChapelierFou
#MaisonAlaïa #AzzedineAlaïa #AlaïaEditions #Alaïa
title: Editions - Chapter 3

description:
The Corset bag launches for the first time as part of the Editions collection.
Its distinctive design however dates back to 1992, introduced during the fashion show of SS 92, the same year Azzedine imagined the corset belt that has defined the Alaïa silhouette, cinched at the waist, over decades. Designed in signature Vienne perforated leather inspired by an Arab-Andalusian lace motif, the Corset bag carries forward the iconic curved design in an ornamental and precious statement.
#MaisonAlaïa #AzzedineAlaïa #AlaïaEditions #Alaïa
title: The Corset Bag Summer 2020

description:
From Tina Turner to Stephanie Seymour, Azzedine Alaïa’s muses were die-hard fans of the shirt and corset belt, which has been part of Alaïa’s vocabulary since it made its first appearance in 1986. This typical Alaïa silhouette, which accentuates the waist and amplifies the lower back, naturally ties in with the sculptural accents of the light skirt –buttoned up nicely at the front with tumbling folds in the back.
#MaisonAlaïa #AzzedineAlaïa #AlaïaEditions #Alaïa
title: The Basque Shirt Summer 1986

description:
Beneath the airy allure of the silhouette of this garment is a rigorous construction. Meticulous drapery work is used to gather the fabric around the waist, supporting the bust and hugging the torso. Elastic is used to ensure the fabric hangs from the body in just the right way while revealing a flash of skin. The inbuilt corset, which provides a hidden structure, gives the dress its essence.
#MaisonAlaïa #AzzedineAlaïa #AlaïaEditions #Alaïa
title: The Goddess Dress Summer 2004

description:
With Editions, ALAÏA continues to develop on its own heritage and modernity. This wardrobe includes around 20 looks that shaped the history of the Maison, showing how pieces from different periods can be styled together and discovered anew. Selected from different collections, the pieces come together with a sense of rediscovery.
Music by @ChapelierFou
#MaisonAlaïa #AzzedineAlaïa #AlaïaEditions #Alaïa
title: Editions - Chapter 2

description:
As part of Wednesday’s immersive performance at the Gaîté Lyrique celebrating the launch of Alaïa Editions, @LoicPrigent filmed dancer @HajibaFahmy, artist Etienne Guiol and choreographer @BrieucBreitenstein describing this singular expression of dance, projection, light and design. Discover the event unfolding onstage and off in this video.
#MaisonAlaïa #AzzedineAlaïa #AlaïaEditions #Alaïa
title: Alaïa eternal innovation

description:
An artistic performance featuring dancer @HajibaFahmy. As an expression of Alaïa’s modernity, pieces from Editions will appear simultaneously projected, illuminated and embodied with sensuality and strength. Through this multi-dimensional event, creation evokes emotion. Heritage becomes transmission. 
Music @ChapelierFou
#MaisonAlaïa #AzzedineAlaïa #AlaïaEditions #Alaïa
title: Alaïa's Editions performance

description:
With its impeccable waist-hugging upper body plunging into a gored corolla skirt that encircles the lower hips, this dress is a piece of poetry that refuses to reveal the secrets of its verses. This seamless garment, made from a single piece of material, owes its three-dimensional volume solely to the prodigious techniques used to make it. The masterful pique rib is stitched by a machine specifically designed for this purpose. Azzedine Alaïa devoted many hours to developing the machine in Italy, in the workshop labs of the manufacturer he worked with.
#MaisonAlaïa #AzzedineAlaïa #AlaïaEditions #Alaïa
title: The Piqué DressSummer 2013

description:
Sewn from a multitude of cotton frills that flutter all the way down its lower section, this garment alternates between transparencies by imitating the geometric effects of lace. This plush effect is also created thanks to a joyful collision of patterns between the different rows of frills, as well as the hidden structure that gives the garment its volume. In an homage to the crinoline dresses of the 18th century, several tiers of horsehair are inserted into the opaque part of the dress in order to give it its volume and airy outer texture.
#MaisonAlaïa #AzzedineAlaïa #AlaïaEditions #Alaïa
title: The Crinoline Dress, Summer 2007

description:
Alaïa Editions have arrived. As an iconic wardrobe respectfully recreated from the archives, Editions carry forth the essence of ALAÏA: its eternal innovation. They reflect Monsieur Alaïa’s inimitable approach to beauty, his sense of sensuality and his flawless technique.
Music by @ChapelierFou
#MaisonAlaïa #AzzedineAlaïa #AlaïaEditions #Alaïa
title: Editions - Chapter 1

description:
With the development of Editions, the Maison ALAÏA embraces heritage and modernity as the complementary expressions of a singular timelessness.
Editions is a wardrobe from the ALAÏA archives that comprises a permanent offer accompanied by a selection linked to the seasonal collection. These pieces have been respectfully recreated by the ateliers according to their original designs and reflect Mr. Alaïa’s inimitable approach to beauty, his sense of sensuality and his flawless technique. Inside each garment, the label will indicate the season and year – a tribute to the past, renewed in the present.
By @loicprigent
#MaisonAlaïa #AzzedineAlaïa #AlaïaEditions #Alaïa
title: Alaïa Editions
